bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to elections; reinstating eligibility requirements for caucus participation.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+REVIVAL AND REENACTMENT. +]

[+Minnesota Statutes, section 202A.16, subdivisions 1 to 3, are revived and reenacted effective retroactively from July 1, 2023. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to elections; reinstating eligibility requirements for caucus participation.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. REVIVAL AND REENACTMENT.

Minnesota Statutes, section 202A.16, subdivisions 1 to 3, are revived and reenacted effective retroactively from July 1, 2023.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: Minnesota Statutes, section 202A.16, subdivisions 1 to 3, are revived and reenacted effective retroactively from July 1, 2023.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
